script_text: Stop! Aries, the Solar Eclipse is screaming loudly at you right this moment. Do not sign anything unsigned without a lawyer present, or your hard-earned finances will quietly slip through your 2nd House net forever. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you do not miss the cosmic fallout coming your way this week ahead.
